_comment: One item of exitRules[]: exit when the individual clicks any link in an email. Event-triggered variant: no conditions. associatedContent is the email's ManagedContent Id (20Y...), as a stringValue. specificLink is required; ANY means any link. Replace the associatedContent placeholder with this org's ManagedContent Id for the email (SELECT Id FROM ManagedContent WHERE Name = '<email title>' AND ContentTypeFullyQualifiedName = 'sfdc_cms__email').
name: Exit_On_First_Email_Click
label: Exit On First Email Click
